title: Maphub v2
wikitext: {{Infobox map |name=Maphub v2 |year=January, 2025 |image=Maphub v2 thumb.jpg |creator={{player|bps|flag=se}} |gametype=Start map |size=Large |family=[[Maphub v1]] |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/maphub_v2.bsp |loc= |link= }} [[File:Maphub v2 overview.png|thumb|200px|Overview]]'''Maphub v2''' is the second iteration of the server default map, where players can see popular maps in various categories and enter them through teleporters. Crafting started in summer [[2024]], with release planned for Christmas. Technical difficulties and optimizations delayed final release to February, 2025. Maphub v2 use alot more geometry from each of the 186 maps, to give each teleporter entrance more detail and visually helping players see "what you get". == Trailer == {{#ev:youtube|hTWpmpwFD6A|}} == Changes == * New cave in start halls with "BIG" maps * Formed "RACE" room now comines "RACE / SLIDE / TRICK" in a 3-level room with 60 teleporters * In "4ON4" room, at the far end is a section with [[The Wizard's Manse|CS]] maps * In "1ON1" room, above [[ztndm3]], is a section with frost versions of {{Abbr|TB5|The Big Five}} * "2ON2" teleporter replaced by "WIPEOUT" (since it was a clone of "1ON1" anyway). * '''186 teleporters''' ([[maphub_v1]] had 96) * File size: 29,7mb ([[maphub_v1]]: 7.9mb) ==Gallery== File:Maphub v2 1on1 room.jpg|1on1 File:Maphub v2 ctf-entrance.jpg|CTF entrance File:Maphub v2 main big.jpg|New "BIG" cave File:Maphub v2 ctf-entrance-fun-wipeout.jpg|Window shattered to "FUN" File:Maphub v2 ctf-race-slide-trick.jpg|"RACE", "SLIDE" & "TRICK" in 3 floors File:Maphub v2 race-slope.jpg|New entrance to "RACE", "SLIDE" & "TRICK" File:Maphub v2 4on4 cs balcony.jpg|CS alcove in 4on4 room == Known quirks == * To open the race gate, /practice need to be enabled. Server should have maphub_v2.cfg in ktx/configs/usermodes/ (containing set srv_practice_mode 1) to always enable this. * Some ezQuake settings (gl_modulate with gl_outline) makes sign texts appear invisible/unreadable. Finding the right combination of gl_outline_world_normal_threshold and gl_outline_world_depth_threshold might help. == Credits == * {{player|infiniti|flag=ca}} - Collaborator and tester * {{player|alice|flag=se}} - Collaborator and tester * {{player|Andeh|flag=se}} - Tester * {{player|Nano|flag=se}} - Tester * {{player|ericw|flag=|link=false}} - Tester * {{player|BLooD_DoG|flag=ca}} - Maps selection contributor * {{player|BogoJoker|flag=us}} - Maps selection contributor * {{player|Zorak|flag=us}} - Maps selection contributor * {{player|velocity|flag=se}} - Maps selection contributor * {{player|VVD|flag=ru}} - Maps selection contributor * {{player|mushi|flag=pt}} - Maps selection contributor * {{player|Link|flag=no}} - Maps selection contributor __NOTOC__
